Interface Calculator

public interface Calculator
Calculator provides methods to perform calculations on objects of type Order and Order.Item.

      long calculateIncludedVAT(long grossPrice, double vatRate)
      Calculate the VAT included in a gross price.
      Parameters:

      vatRate - tax rate to apply, e.g. a value of 0.19 for a 19% rate
      Returns:

    • taxRate

      double taxRate(VAT vatCode)
      Return the current tax rate that apply to a VAT as 1/100-th, e.g. for a tax rate of 19%, value 0.19 is returned.
      Parameters:
      vatCode - vatCode for which the current tax rate is returned.
      Returns:
      current tax rate.
